I spot-checked this against several original rows mod 7, and they matched.

**Step 2: First lift.** Compute b1 = (b − A·d0)/7 exactly. Every entry of b − A·d0 was divisible by 7, which confirms d0 is correct mod 7. This gives

b1 = [-113, -17, -8, 31, -5, 27, 54, -95, -8, -51, -48, -10, 30, -75, -23]
